article.title: WPP Media聯手Viewerslogic，把LLM活動納入購物旅程觀察
article.title_en: WPP Media partners with Viewerslogic to observe LLM activity in purchase journeys
article.summary: The Media Leader報道，WPP Media與Viewerslogic合作，把LLM活動連同媒體接觸及購物行為納入旅程觀察。
article.summary_en: The Media Leader reports that WPP Media and Viewerslogic will examine LLM activity alongside media exposure and shopping behavior.
highlights: 方法使用一萬名自願加入的英國用戶面板。
觀察電視、手機瀏覽、購物及LLM活動，並非對香港消費者的推算。
highlights_en: The described method uses an opt-in panel of 10,000 UK users.
It observes TV, mobile browsing, shopping and LLM activity; it is not a Hong Kong population estimate.
article.why: AI發現加入跨接點旅程後，品牌可把「被AI提及」與「之後有否到站購物」分開追問，決定衡量計劃需要哪些行為連接。
article.why_en: Connected journey observation lets brands distinguish AI mentions from subsequent site visits and purchases when specifying measurement.
article.next_step: 為一個英國活動列出曝光、LLM使用、到站及購物四個接點，向供應商確認可觀察範圍、樣本適配及缺失資料，再決定研究設計。
article.next_step_en: Map exposure, LLM use, site visits and shopping for one UK campaign, then confirm sample fit and observable gaps before designing the study.
article.detail: 這是活動現場的直接報道，方法與功能仍按供應商描述歸因，並無本刊獨立測試。把不同接點放在同一條旅程，可提出更具體的研究問題，例如品牌接觸與AI搜尋的先後次序。觀察到先後或關聯不能單獨證明廣告造成購買；報道亦不提供把英國面板外推至香港的依據，因此本篇不採用未覆核方法的效果百分比。
article.detail_en: This is direct event reporting of a supplier-described method, not our product test. Connected observations can support questions about the sequence of brand exposure and AI discovery. Sequence alone does not establish that advertising caused purchases. We omit effectiveness percentages whose methodology was not examined and make no Hong Kong extrapolation.
